mara.activity: Coffee, toast, and checking the weather and transit alerts before work
mara.intention: Have breakfast and check for any delays before leaving.

mara.activity: Get dressed, wash up, and gather work things
mara.intention: Get ready for the office and make sure I have my essentials.
Travel to work with enough time to settle in before the morning starts.

mara.activity: Transportation planning work, meetings, and reviewing street-project maps
mara.intention: Attend the Monday staff meeting, review project material, and handle normal planning work.

mara.activity: Commute home and put work things away
mara.intention: Return home, change out of work mode, and leave my backpack ready for the next workday.

mara.activity: Answer a few messages and sort the incoming mail
mara.intention: Clear a small amount of correspondence without letting the mail stack spread across the table.

mara.activity: Change clothes and have a quiet transition while Daniel cooks
mara.intention: Let Daniel handle dinner and decompress before we sit down together.
Eat the dinner Daniel has prepared and catch up about the day.

mara.activity: Gentle stretching and watch a television episode
mara.intention: Ease out of the workday and give my back and shoulders some attention.

mara.activity: Wash up, prepare for bed, and read briefly
mara.intention: Finish the day calmly and set myself up for tomorrow.

daniel.activity: Shower, get dressed, pack the repair bag and tools, and eat a quick breakfast.
daniel.intention: Be ready for the first repair call without lingering over breakfast.

daniel.activity: Carry the repair bag and lunch container to the truck, put the truck keys on the entry coat rack's middle-right hook after unlocking the truck, and leave for the first call.
daniel.intention: Get out the door on time with the tools and lunch.

daniel.activity: Drive between appliance repair calls, diagnose appliances, complete repairs, and eat lunch between appointments.
daniel.intention: Stay on schedule through the Monday service route.

daniel.activity: Drive home from the last service call and carry the repair bag inside.
daniel.intention: Get home and transition out of the workday.

daniel.activity: Change out of work clothes, put the work clothes in the laundry hamper, and check tomorrow's service calls on my phone.
daniel.intention: Get cleaned up and make sure tomorrow's route is clear before cooking.

daniel.activity: Wash my hands, take the frying pan and ingredients to the stove, and set my pocket notebook on the counter right of the stove.
daniel.intention: Set up dinner before Mara gets home and avoid misplacing the day's notes.

daniel.activity: Cook a one-pot pasta dinner and carry the finished food to the dining table.
daniel.intention: Have dinner ready for conversation when Mara is home.

daniel.activity: Eat dinner and talk with Mara at the dining table.
daniel.intention: Have a proper meal and catch up on the day.

daniel.activity: Sit on the sofa, watch television, and read sports news; briefly tighten a loose household screw if I notice one.
daniel.intention: Unwind after the route without starting a large project.

daniel.activity: Brush my teeth, take allergy tablets, and change into sleep clothes.
daniel.intention: Finish the bedtime routine and settle down.
Rest before the next service day.
